title: Oozy Mediterranean Cheese Lasagna
description: A lazy Sunday Mediterranean dish featuring shredded Monterey Jack cheese with a mustardy flavor, perfect for a cheese-pull experience. This shojin-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the chopped sun dried tomatoes for 2 minutes.
Add the artichoke hearts, Kalamata olives, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the shredded Monterey Jack cheese and Dijon mustard, stirring until well combined.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a thin layer of the tomato and artichoke mixture.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the mixture.
Spread half of the cheese and mustard mixture over the noodles.
Repeat the layers, starting with the tomato and artichoke mixture, then the noodles, and finally the remaining cheese and mustard mixture.
Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
